text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! It happened again! I found more
crop
circles!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: R-really? Are you sure you're not just—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I swear I wasn't imaginin' things! Cross
my heart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It was by the riverbank and in the tall
grass by the
park! There were these
swirly-lookin' circles in the
grass!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But I was training in both of those
areas
recently...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Does that mean you're callin' the
UFOs
here?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, of course not. That's just—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... I trained in the last place she
found
circles in too. Does that... mean...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
N-no way... Am I really... summoning
aliens?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Only one way to find out! Let's go train
on the
roof! ☆
